title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates billing so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It depends on openmrs/openmrs-core#6637 and on the Platform 3 upgrades of fhir2 (6.x), idgen (openmrs/openmrs-module-idgen#140) and stockmanagement (openmrs/openmrs-module-stockmanagement#49). Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, on Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (with `openmrs-bom` imported).
  - It uses fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT (the `fhir2-api-2.x` artifacts are gone), idgen 7.0.0-SNAPSHOT, stockmanagement 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT and webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - `mockito-inline` is replaced by the BOM's `mockito-core`, and reflections now comes from core (`provided`).
  - Bamboo and the release workflow use JDK 21.
- Orders are billed from core's entity events instead of the event module, which has no Platform 3 build (openmrs/openmrs-module-event#33 was closed).
  - `OrderBillingEventListener` listens for core's `SaveDbEvent` once the saving transaction commits, and ignores updates the way the old `CREATED` subscription did.
  - Core only raises that event for a new order with openmrs/openmrs-core#6637.
  - The event-api dependency and the event `require_module` are gone.
- `openmrsPlatformToolsVersion` is pinned to 2.7.8. Otherwise spotless picks up the 3.0 formatter and reformats every file.
- uiframework, appframework and providermanagement were only referenced in comments, so their jars are removed from the poms. The `aware_of_module` entries stay, so those modules remain optional.
- The generic entity/DAO framework was built on `org.hibernate.Criteria`.
  - It now uses a small JPA-criteria replacement, `EntityCriteria`, with the same restrictions, ordering, paging, lock mode and row count.
  - `CriteriaImplWrapper` is deleted, and saves use `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`.
  - `CustomizedOrderBy` and the `Base*TemplateSearch` classes, which nothing used, are deleted rather than ported.
- `HibernateBillDAO.saveBill` keeps `BillLineItem.lineItemOrder` in step with the list position. Hibernate 7 no longer writes the inverse list index when the element maps that column itself.
- Hibernate 7 mappings and API:
  - In hbm, `native` becomes `identity` and `org.hibernate.type.EnumType` becomes core's `StringEnumType`.
  - `@Enumerated(STRING)` gets `@JdbcTypeCode(VARCHAR)`.
  - `saveOrUpdate`/`delete` become `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`/`remove`.
- javax becomes jakarta (servlet, persistence, annotations), commons-lang becomes lang3, and Jackson 1 becomes Jackson 2.
- `Daemon.runInDaemonThread` becomes `runInDaemonThreadWithoutResult`.
- REST `supportedOpenmrsVersions` widens from `"2.0 - 2.*"` to `"2.0 - 9.*"`. The service `TransactionProxyFactoryBean`s are unchanged.
- Tests are migrated to JUnit 5. `OrderBillingOnCommitTest` saves orders through `OrderService` and checks that they are billed after the commit.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes on JDK 21 and 25: api 513, fhir 6, omod 54. That is against openmrs-core master with #6637 merged in, plus local builds of idgen#140 and stockmanagement#49. On core master without #6637, all three `OrderBillingOnCommitTest` tests fail, because no event is raised for a new order.
- On d8d665f, before the event module came out, on openmrs-core master with openmrs/openmrs-core#6631 and #6633 (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8), in the full set of 26 upgraded O3 modules:
  - All modules start, and logging in through the UI works.
  - `billing/billableService`, `billing/cashPoint` and `billing/paymentMode` return 200.
- billing maps its enums with core's `StringEnumType`, so it needs #6633 to start on core master.

title: Update README.md
Fix patient payment status returning PAID when no active bills exist
body: Patients with no bills used to return `PAID`, while this was technically the intended behaviour, it's confusing to see the `PAID` tag on a patient when they have no bills at all. This changes that to instead return unknown if a patient has no bills.

title: Fix orphaned payment_status column on cashier_bill_line_item
body:
On DBs where both payment_status and status ended up on cashier_bill_line_item after a partial migration, every line-item insert failed with Field 'payment_status' doesn't have a default value

  - Tighten changeset 009 precondition so the rename only runs when status does not already exist
  - Add changeset 009b to backfill from payment_status and drop it when both columns exist
  - Pin <validCheckSum> on 009 so already-migrated DBs accept the precondition change

title: Show discounts and refunds on bill receipts
body: - Receipt now shows line-scoped discounts under each line item, plus Subtotal / Total Discount / Total in the totals block - New Refund section lists completed refunds with their reason - Due-amount math accounts for refunds - Fix NPE in Bill.synchronizeBillStatus() when payments is null - Add Liquibase 009b to drop orphaned payment_status column when both columns exist

title: Add refundStatus filter to GET /bill and expose refunds in bill representation
body:
## Summary

- Adds a `refundStatus` query parameter to `GET /rest/v1/billing/bill` so callers can filter bills by the status of their associated refunds (e.g. `?refundStatus=REQUESTED` or `?refundStatus=REQUESTED,COMPLETED`)
- Validates that only known `RefundStatus` enum values are accepted; throws `InvalidSearchException` if the parameter is present but resolves to no valid values
- Exposes `refunds` in both the DEFAULT and FULL `BillResource` representations so clients receive refund data without needing a separate request

## Changes

- `BillResource`: parse and validate `refundStatus` param; add `refunds` to DEFAULT/FULL rep descriptions
- `HibernateBillDAOTest`: additional assertions covering bills with no refund rows and multi-status deduplication with voided refunds
- `BillRefundStatusFilterTest.xml`: new bill 2006 fixture (no refund rows) to verify the EXISTS predicate correctly excludes it
- `BillResourceTest`: representation description test asserting `refunds` is present in DEFAULT and FULL reps

title: Delete bill discounts and refunds when purging bill
body: This PR adds a liquibase changeset to cascade discounts and refunds when a bill is purged. Currently, if you try to purge a bill, you’d get a foreign key constraint exception.

title: O3-5410: Display Billing Payment Status Without Blocking Access to Clinical Forms
body:
Adds a new REST endpoint to determine whether a patient has any outstanding bills.

- GET /rest/v1/billing/patientPaymentStatus/{patientUuid} returns { status: PAID | UNPAID, reason }
- Default resolver derives status from Bill records: PENDING or POSTED (and non-voided) → UNPAID, everything else → PAID
- Pluggable via the billing.patientPaymentStatusResolver global property: set to the fully qualified class name of a Spring-registered
  PatientPaymentStatusResolver bean to override
- Returns 400 for blank UUIDs, 404 for unknown patients, 500 (logged) for resolver/config errors
- 
Ticket: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5410

title: O3-5421: Associate bills with patient visits
body:
## Summary

Adds an optional `visit` association to `Bill` so bills can be linked to the visit they were generated during. The visit can be supplied explicitly via the REST API, is auto-populated from a patient's single active visit on create, and is auto-set from an order's encounter when a bill is generated from orders. Bills can also be filtered by `visitUuid`.

## Changes

- Schema: add `visit_id` column to `cashier_bill` with `ON DELETE SET NULL` / `ON UPDATE CASCADE`
- Entity: `Bill.visit` field with Hibernate mapping
- REST: expose `visit` on `BillResource` (DEFAULT/FULL reps + creatable property); accept `visitUuid` query param on bill search
- Search: `BillSearch.visitUuid` filter wired through criteria
- Auto-population: when creating a bill without a visit, use the patient's single active visit (skip if multiple)
- Order-driven: when generating a bill from orders, set the visit from the order's encounter

title: Enable refund and discount features by default
body: Flip the default values of the `billing.discountEnabled` and `billing.refundEnabled` global properties from `false` to `true` so the discount and refund workflows shipped in O3-5417 and O3-5413 are active out of the box.

title: O3-5422: Introduce a dedicated `BillLineItemStatus`
body:
Introduce a dedicated `BillLineItemStatus` enum for `BillLineItem`, replacing the shared `BillStatus`. Drops the bill-only `POSTED` value and adds  `REFUND_REQUESTED`, `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED`, `REFUNDED` so line items reflect the state of line-scoped refunds.

- New `BillLineItemStatus` enum; `BillLineItem.paymentStatus` → `status` (field, column, REST JSON property).
- `BillRefundServiceImpl` reconciles line-item status on every line-scoped refund save, mirroring the existing bill-level rollup.
- `Bill.synchronizeBillStatus()` no longer overwrites a refund-state line item.
- Liquibase: migrate legacy `POSTED` line items → `PENDING`, widen + rename `payment_status` → `status`, widen `cashier_bill.status`.
- REST: `lineItem.paymentStatus` → `lineItem.status`. Frontend / ESM consumers must update.

Ticket: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5422

title: O3-5417: Filter bills by discount status
body:
## Summary

Adds a `discountStatus` query parameter to `GET /ws/rest/v1/cashier/bill` so callers can filter bills by the status of their (non-voided) discounts. Supports comma-separated values mapping to the `DiscountStatus` enum.

- `BillSearch` gains a `discountStatuses` list.
- `HibernateBillDAO` filters via an `EXISTS` subquery on non-voided `BillDiscount` rows — avoids the row multiplication / `DISTINCT` workaround that an inner join would require.
- `BillResource` parses the param and rejects unknown values with `InvalidSearchException` (400) instead of leaking the enum's `IllegalArgumentException` as a 500.

## Related Issue

https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5417

## Test Plan

- [x] Unit tests in `BillSearchTest`, `HibernateBillDAOTest`, `BillResourceTest` cover: single status, multiple statuses, voided discount exclusion, invalid value rejection, and absence of the param.
- [x] Full mvn test (api + omod): 411 tests, 0 failures.

title: Migrate build to maven-parent-openmrs-module 2.1.0
body:
Inherits from the OpenMRS contrib maven parent so the module picks up the standard plugin versions, license/spotless wiring, and CI release profiles.

* Drop redundant pluginManagement for compiler, surefire, release, jar, openmrs-plugin, dependency-plugin, formatter-maven-plugin, and the m2e lifecycle-mapping. Drop the legacy `release` and `openmrs-2.0` profiles.
* Rename `openMRSVersion` -> `openmrsPlatformVersion` (the parent's dependencyManagement for openmrs-api/web/test is keyed off this name). Update omod/config.xml `<require_version>` to match.
* Switch maven.compiler.source/target from `1.8` to `8` and set as properties; the parent's enforcer regex `^([89]|[1-9]\d+)$` rejects `1.8`.
* Re-declare distributionManagement pointing at mavenrepo.openmrs.org in the child pom; the contrib GHA `infer_backend_params.py` reads it from the child only and does not follow parent inheritance.
* Re-declare repositories/pluginRepositories at mavenrepo.openmrs.org /public so Maven can resolve the parent POM itself.
* Configure javadoc with `<doclint>none</doclint>` and `<failOnError>false</failOnError>` so the parent's `ci`-profile javadoc step doesn't choke on legacy comments.
* In api/omod/fhir submodule poms, switch openmrs-api `<type>test-jar</type>` to `<classifier>tests</classifier>` to match the parent's dependencyManagement key. Drop formatter-maven-plugin references (the parent uses spotless instead).

title: Apply standard OpenMRS MPL license headers
body: Auto-generated by maven-parent-openmrs-module's license-maven-plugin (license:format on process-sources). Lands the headers ahead of the parent-pom migration so that PR's diff stays focused on the build config.

O3 5417: Bill Discount Management with Audit Trail
body:
- New `BillDiscount` entity + `bill_discount` table with full audit fields (initiator, approver, value, amount, justification, timestamp)
  - `Bill.getAmountAfterDiscount()` and `synchronizeBillStatus()` now reconcile against the discounted total, so a 10% discount lets the patient pay 
  90% and auto-flip to `PAID`                          
  - `BillDiscountService` / DAO / REST resource at `/ws/rest/v1/cashier/billDiscount`, guarded by new `Manage Bill Discounts` / `View Bill Discounts`
   privileges                                                                                                                                        
  - Validator enforces: feature enabled (`billing.discountEnabled` global property, default `false`), bill status in {`PENDING`, `POSTED`}, positive
  value, amount ≤ bill total, mandatory justification, one active discount per bill (voided rows can be replaced)                                    
  - `BillResource` exposes `discount`, `totalAmount`, `amountAfterDiscount` for invoice/receipt display                                              
  - 18 tests (7 DAO + 11 service) covering happy paths, rejections, and void-and-reapply
                                                                                                                                                     
  Ticket: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5417

title: O3-5370: Auto-Generate Billable Items from Medication Orders
body:
- Replace broken AOP interceptors (GenerateBillFromOrderAdvice, OrderCreationMethodBeforeAdvice) with OpenMRS Events module for order billing
  - Subscribe to Order.CREATED events to auto-generate bills when orders are saved
  - Implement Strategy pattern (OrderBillingStrategy) for per-order-type billing rules
  - Handle NEW, REVISE (void old + create new), and DISCONTINUE (void old) order actions
  - Add BillingEventListener interface for auto-discovery new listeners only need a Spring bean, no activator changes
  - Fix BillLineItem.order HBM mapping so order-to-line-item link actually persists
  - Add getBillLineItemByOrder() to DAO/service layer for looking up line items by order
